decisions.reason: Selecting the Business Case site list does not change the capex estimates, assumption basis, or shared-cost treatment. The separate capex clause in the same message is already represented by its own MODIFY.
The site-list selection does not change the operating-cost range or its source. The independent opex decision in the same message is already represented by its own MODIFY.
The selected site list does not necessarily alter the required revenue streams, pricing-assumption basis, or documentation rule.
Choosing the Business Case site list has no effect on the model's CAD currency or 2026 price base year.
The network site-list decision does not change the capital structure, financing rate, debt tranches, or refinement trigger. The independent financing clause is already represented by its own MODIFY.
The selected site list does not change the DSCR or equity-IRR sizing thresholds. The independent availability-payment clause is already represented by its own MODIFY.
The site-list source does not change the required CCA method, asset-class examples, or modeled tax effects. The independent tax clause is already represented by its own MODIFY.
The general obligation to annotate assumptions and use approved sources remains valid unchanged. The site-specific source resolution belongs to the network-configuration Requirement.

The requirement to verify and reconcile source data remains unchanged. Recording the site-list choice here would duplicate the target-specific state already owned by the network-configuration Requirement.
The choice of site list does not change the required comparison between the user-funded and PPP availability-payment scenarios.
The site-list selection does not change the integrated three-statement structure or the required financial-engine rebuild.
Selecting a source for the site list does not alter the requirement that worksheet formulas and links operate correctly.
